hypothesis: A fixed old-example replay allocation lets bounded adaptive feedback retain a useful post-change learning advantage without exceeding2pp loss on old facts against equally replayed frozen feedback.
primary_metric: Per-seed equal mean of novel CE at steps544..768 every32 and drift CE at1056..1280 every32 (16 checkpoints); arithmetic mean of three paired relative CE reductions.
minimum_useful_effect: Mean relative CE reduction>=5%; every seed>=0%.
success_rule: All finite/fidelity/data/replay gates, mean CE effect>=5% and no negative seed; adaptive_mixed old-window and final-old accuracy at most2pp worse than frozen_mixed in each seed.
futility_rule: No tuning or added seeds. Stop on fidelity, preservation, pilot numerical failure or exhausted budget; preserve all failed arms. Main arm failure invalidates the primary gate. Retention or effect failure means no promotion.

design.control_rationale: Adaptive/frozen × FIFO/mixed factorial plus BP under both policies. Same current stream, initial512 memory examples, uniform replay random draws, minibatch32, replay16 and total512-example storage. Mixed policy deliberately reallocates storage and changes recent horizon32->16 batches. Magnitude normalization from prior study is not active; this isolates replay allocation with unchanged unnormalized learning rules.
design.seed_selection_method: Fresh consecutive seeds801791..3, separate pilot97987, verification seeds97987/12817/21817. No world/seed search or exclusions.
design.matching_track: Same model/start/lr/decay/exposure/replay samples and storage, no trial selection. Replay data content is the treatment. BP and local methods have different compute costs, which are reported.
design.compute_accounting: Shared BP-forward/local-feedback warmup once per seed; dense SVD caps, two schedule generations/hash checks, all exact diagnostic gradients and full online replays charged. Per-worker RSS measured; concurrent peak, FLOPs and deployment latency unmeasured.

evaluation.primary_endpoint: Per-seed equal mean of novel CE at steps544..768 every32 and drift CE at1056..1280 every32 (16 checkpoints); arithmetic mean of three paired relative CE reductions.
evaluation.duplicate_policy: All6 arms for pilot and all3 main seeds repeat the entire online stream from serialized common warmup and independently regenerated/hash-verified schedules. All4 phase and final complete-state hashes plus stored final tensors must match bitwise.

Within-policy mixed-minus-FIFO, adaptive-minus-frozen replay interactions, BP controls and direction probes descriptive; no choosing a favorable comparator.
